snippet.title: Arise Dark Lord - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the prototype now at https://subversion-studios.itch.io/arise  

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4622160/Arise_Dark_Lord/

Announcing the 8th game from Introversion Software - Arise Dark Lord.  Raise an evil army, and crush the race of men. An action-strategy hybrid RTS, blending tower defence, base building and direct control of your Dark Lord avatar.

You are The Dark Lord, and your goal is to raise an undead army and crush the feckless, godless heathens known as humans. As your sorcery and your evil army grow, all of the world will rise up against you to destroy your Dark Tower and end your reign of terror. Fortify your dark realm, upgrade your sorcery, and build enough strength to march out and crush the humans once and for all.

Introversion Software are the BAFTA and IGF award winning developers of seven indie videogames including Prison Architect, DEFCON, Darwinia and The Last Starship.  
Arise Dark Lord is in early development, and is due for release sometime in 2027.
